title: Cinnime acwah quuka
intro: Sahdayti baxi aydaadih uddur, ardi uxih qunxuk sugeeh, baad naharsi ufuy ruubak suge wak, inki rooci Gineh foocal rammitle fida luk sooleh. Too fida qilsa le diini oggol — kee faxximtam geytimte. Ciggiltam qafuuta hinnay, aysinu edde culte sorkocô baxi, inkih tan waktil edde cultah tan abto fanah gexak sugte. tah inki numih aydaadu kay migaq qimboh addah qadli sinna luk sitta ceela.
clues: Anu qimmoh yooboke urruk tiyak teyna akkuk manol emeete, atu nagay taaxigeh tan aydaadu xaleenak yooboke.
Anu inki adda Yallih fida abeeh, laakin yok oggol mali — takkay immay yi toobokoh fida qaynat luk geytimte.
Aysinuu kee bakcarra yi sorkocô baxat raddem kee anu inni ramadah mano sooliseyyom meysiiseh.
Yi toobokoyti Yallak meysitak yoo takkawseh, takkay immay yi kaxxiina yoo ankacissam madudda.
bohoy le qaku le uddur, anu inni toobokoytal yaabe sinni abto abe.
Tohuk lakal, anu abeh an taama elle qammaalaanam faxximtam aaxaguk masugiyyo — ardi bagul yan gino yoo barsaanam fan.

Isi dirkik yawqeenimih kaxxa kullumti yanxuqe
trial.answer: Cinnimte fida xayyoosaanam, naharsi qidimih miraacissa

Inkih tan ummatta edde boodde kaxxa weeqi.
rooci le baaxoh alluwwa fan korte taama abeynit
is-gaali too xaahi qalek tewqe

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Nadaama tekke, quukak qimbol tekke baatil
Yallih cabsu abeeh, amotani jannat kaa teceeh.
Fayyale nabiyyih guddaaqa fan ugte
Diteh addaak seeco abeeniik widiril yallih racmatta cattiime
Jinniiy, caacay kee baditteh amol reeda yomcowweh suge
outcome.answer: Nadaama tekke, quukak qimbol tekke baatil

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
